cloud.notes: No cloud interface or account is needed for these local BLE paths.

manufacturer_data.description: Legacy BM2 percentage advertisement; enhanced records use a ciphertext-derived ID.

methods.notes: Names and service UUIDs are selection leads, not telemetry authentication. Active validation requires FFF4, a decryptable 16-byte F5 notification, plausible values and a known status. Missing FFF4 is incompatible; a timeout or connection failure is inconclusive.

manufacturer_data.description: Legacy percentage-only advertisements use company ID 0x004c and a fixed prefix. Enhanced advertisements instead derive their manufacturer ID from the first two ciphertext bytes, so there is no second fixed ID to declare. Length and plausible decoded values alone are weak identity.

device.name: Quicklynks BM2 Battery Monitor
device.notes:
Read-only BM2 / Battery Monitor 2 telemetry over BLE. Active monitoring subscribes to FFF4 and decrypts one 16-byte notification; passive monitoring can decode enhanced and legacy manufacturer advertisements. Do not extend this spec to BM6, whose encrypted/rotating advertisements are different.
The shared published AES key and zero IV are protocol constants, not owner credentials or secure pairing. Deterministic encryption does not authenticate a sender. Require the expected GATT shape, packet type, voltage/percentage ranges and known status before publishing active data. The 5.0-20.0 V and 0-100 percent ranges are client sanity bounds, not verified electrical operating limits.
History, FFF3 writes, cranking/charging-test retrieval, FEE0/FEE1, OAD, firmware, configuration, chemistry selection, voltage-curve interpolation and alarm thresholds are outside this read-only spec.

openness.notes: The first client supplies AES framing, notification handling and voltage extraction. The second independently supplies percentage/status fields, enhanced/legacy advertisements and active/passive behavior.

pairing.notes: The fixed protocol transform is not pairing and provides no sender authentication.

credentials.notes: The published protocol AES constant is not an owner credential. No account or protected owner data is required.

factory_reset.effect: No genuine BM2 manual or factory-reset procedure was established. Passive use has no state to reset.

methods.description: Connect, subscribe to FFF4, decrypt and validate one fresh F5 notification, then stop notifications and disconnect.
methods.name: Active FFF4 telemetry

steps.action: Select a BM2 using the established name/service leads and discover FFF4.
Subscribe to FFF4 and wait for a fresh notification without writing FFF3.
Require exactly 16 ciphertext bytes, decrypt using protocol_details.encryption, then validate the F5 type, values and status.
Stop notifications and disconnect, including on timeout. Preserve cache age if falling back to advertisements.

methods.description: Decode enhanced or legacy manufacturer data without connecting, preferring a valid enhanced observation.
methods.name: Passive advertisement telemetry

steps.action: Passively scan manufacturer data and decode protocol_details.enhanced_advertisement or legacy_advertisement.
If an enhanced observation is followed by legacy data, refresh only percentage; retain enhanced voltage/generation and clear status.

setup.notes: No account, cloud, pairing key or application credential is needed for the read-only paths.

rejoin.notes: No bond is required for these paths; reconnect or resume scanning.

testing.notes: Not driven against hardware by this project. Two public clients establish the wire formats; 19 source-level checks passed on 2026-11-03. The vectors below are synthetic and independently checked with the published protocol transform, not captured vehicle data or electrical calibration.

entities.name: Battery Voltage
entities.notes: FFF4: (big-endian word >> 4) / 100. Enhanced advertisement: uint16 BE at decrypted bytes 6-7 divided by 100. Legacy: unavailable.

entities.name: Battery
entities.notes: FFF4 byte 3, enhanced decrypted byte 8, or legacy body byte 22; always require 0-100.

entities.name: Battery Status
entities.notes: FFF4 low nibble only: Critical, Low, Normal, Charging, Floating, or Unknown. Advertisements do not supply status.

entities.name: Charging
entities.notes: Reference client flag is FFF4 status >= 4; preserve the raw enum because this flag is not a complete state model.

artifacts.description: AES framing, FFF4 notification handling and the big-endian/shift voltage decoder; four source checks passed.
Percentage/status fields, enhanced/legacy advertisements, active validation and passive fallback; fifteen source checks passed.

evidence.documentation_review: Reviewed 2026-11-03 research and normalized profile. The spec's independent tests decrypt constructed vectors and check both advertisement generations, packed values and malformed inputs. No live BLE or vehicle was used.
evidence.open_questions: Electrical accuracy, installation limits, actual firmware population, packet cadence, advertisement identity strength and physical reset behavior.

local_access.summary: Active and passive BM2 telemetry work locally without an account or vendor cloud.

Enhanced_Advertisement.description: Fourteen-byte manufacturer body. Prepend its two-byte manufacturer ID in little-endian order to reconstruct one 16-byte encrypted block.

fields.description: Unavailable in this generation; do not infer it.
fields.name: status

parse_rules: Decrypt the reconstructed block and accept voltage 5.0-20.0 V and percentage 0-100 inclusive; reject malformed or implausible values.
Prefer a valid enhanced record over legacy. A later legacy record may refresh percentage but retains enhanced voltage/generation and clears status.

FFF4_Voltage_Status.description: Decrypted FFF4 plaintext: 16 bytes in the validated example, with F5 type, packed voltage/status and percentage.

fields.description: Big-endian packed word; the mask shifts the upper 12 bits down four before scale, giving (word >> 4) x 0.01 V. Status is separate.
fields.name: voltage

fields.description: Low nibble of the word: 0 Critical, 1 Low, 2 Normal, 4 Charging, 8 Floating; other values unknown.
fields.name: status

parse_rules: Require exactly 16 ciphertext bytes, then decrypt AES-128-CBC with protocol_details.encryption.
Require F5, percentage 0-100, voltage 5.0-20.0 V for active validation, and a known status nibble. These are client sanity bounds, not hardware ratings.
A notification timeout is inconclusive, not proof of incompatibility. Always stop notifications and clear advertisement-ignore state afterward.

Legacy_Advertisement.description: Company 0x004c, 23-byte manufacturer body: fixed 18-byte prefix, two major bytes, two minor bytes and one percentage byte.

fields.description: Must equal 02 15 65 5f 83 ca ae 16 a1 0a 70 2e 31 f3 0d 58 dd 82.
fields.name: fixed_prefix

fields.description: Two bytes with no established telemetry meaning.
fields.name: major

fields.description: Two bytes with no established telemetry meaning.
fields.name: minor

parse_rules: Require the exact length and prefix. Voltage and status are unavailable; do not invent them from major/minor.

active_validation.range_semantics: Client sanity bounds, not verified hardware electrical limits.
active_validation.unknown_status_policy: Unknown, never Normal or healthy; reference charging flag is status >= 4 but raw status is retained.

encryption.padding: Zero-fill plaintext to a complete block for encryption; the public decryptor retains zero padding.
encryption.security: Published shared constant, not an owner credential. Fixed key/IV encryption is deterministic and does not authenticate a device or constitute secure pairing.

enhanced_advertisement.identity_caution: Length and plausible values are weak identification; confirm via established discovery or active validation.
enhanced_advertisement.reconstruction: manufacturer_id little-endian uint16 || body = 16 ciphertext bytes; derive a fixture's ID from the first two ciphertext bytes, not an arbitrary value.

read_behavior.cleanup: Stop notifications and clear advertisement-ignore state on success, failure and timeout; disconnect after active polling.
read_behavior.enhanced_legacy_coexistence: Legacy can refresh percentage after enhanced data; retain enhanced voltage/generation and clear cached status.
read_behavior.freshness: The upstream passive cache has no demonstrated expiry. Timestamp it and expose staleness rather than presenting old data as fresh.
read_behavior.no_path_behavior: If neither active nor valid passive data exists, report unavailable rather than a healthy default.
read_behavior.preference: Fresh FFF4 notification first, then latest valid cached advertisement only if active access fails or no connectable path exists.

remaining_unknowns: No genuine BM2 manual was found; electrical, installation and environmental ratings are not asserted.
No physical BM2 was used. Source-level checks do not prove firmware coverage, accuracy or rebrand compatibility.
The enhanced advertisement's manufacturer ID is ciphertext-derived; length and plausible values alone are weak identity.
Passive-cache expiry, notification cadence and all major/minor legacy fields remain unresolved.

format.name: packet_type
format.notes: 0xf5 after decryption; ignore other packet types for this read-only profile.

format.name: voltage
format.notes: Upper 12 bits. The mask shifts them down four places before scale, so 0x5080 becomes 1288 x 0.01 = 12.88 V. Status is a separate low-nibble field.

format.name: status
format.notes: Other values are unknown. The reference charging flag is status >= 4, not a complete state model.

characteristics.name: Encrypted voltage/status notification
characteristics.notes: One 16-byte AES-128-CBC ciphertext block. The plaintext starts with F5. The big-endian word at bytes 1-2 packs voltage in its upper 12 bits and status in its low nibble: voltage = (word >> 4) / 100 V; status = word & 0x0f. Percentage is byte 3. Require the complete block and expected type before applying protocol_details decoding.
